description: The Head Barista is responsible for the overall profitability and the end-to-end operations of the outlet. He/She works closely with the team to monitor preparation of beverages and manage the operational needs of the outlet. He recommends initiatives to boost customer experience and plans activities for continuous improvement within the team. He also monitors the teams compliance to service, food hygiene, health and safety standards. He must have excellent communication and teaching skills, keep a calm, mature, professional demeanour when needed and possesses a proactive approach to problem-solving and staff management. He is able to work in a flexible schedule, including weekends, evenings, and public holidays, and may have to provide support at the workstations during peak periods.

Coordinate crisis response and recovery activities in accordance with business continuity policies

Translate team members' skill requirements into learning and development plans
Review staff roster to ensure adequate manpower for the team
Interview new staff
Analyse inventory levels to propose purchases for the team
Plan operational budgets for the team
Monitor opening, operating, and closing of shifts for the outlet
Monitor the preparation of coffee-based beverages and teas
Monitor the operations of Point of Sales (POS) Systems when managing beverage order
Monitor team's adherence with the organisation's Workplace Safety and Health (WSH) policies and procedures
Monitor team's compliance with the organisation's personal, food and beverage hygiene standards
Monitor team's adherence to the organisation's food waste management Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
